dan_stimulation.onset: fixed Level 2 teacher event time: observation window plus inherited 1000-us lag
dan_stimulation.model: same LIF parameters and dt as the frozen Level 2 circuit; fresh resting DAN state per presentation
dan_stimulation.activity_gate: 1.0 if at least one observed DAN spike during the fixed current pulse; otherwise 0.0
dan_stimulation.ensemble_policy: Stimulate all three DAN bodies simultaneously at every scheduled teaching event; each uses its own fresh resting LIF state.

local_gate.anatomical_rule: A KC→MBON05 weight slot is eligible for DAN-gated LTD only when the KC has local presentation eligibility and at least one DAN in dan_source_ids has a strict same-compartment γ4 contact to that KC and spikes on this presentation. The union of these slots spans the frozen cohort; all 32 weights remain present.
local_gate.plasticity_rule: Level 2 presentation-local eligibility and LTD formula; replace artificial teacher bit by observed DAN spike activity. This is an engineering assumption.
local_gate.no_dan_activity: zero LTD update regardless of eligibility
local_gate.dan_to_mbon05_direct_pair: 48 measured contacts are recorded in the audit but no direct electrical effect is added to this reduced readout; its physiological effect is unknown.
local_gate.dan_gate: per KC: local eligibility AND at least one anatomically connected ensemble DAN spike; no connected DAN spike means zero update.

protocol.trajectory: one note moves linearly from normalized x=1.0 to x=0.0 over one observation window; one fresh resting LIF presentation per note
protocol.input_rule: x(t) = 1 - t / duration; encode x(t) only at each dt tick
protocol.dan_latency_basis: Level 3B pretraining gate: 2.0-mV-equivalent, 20-ms isolated DAN pulse at t=101000 us produced the first spike at t=115000 us; latency is frozen at 14000 us
protocol.teacher_schedule: retain the frozen 1200-row Level 3B schedule labels only for timing external teaching; labels never enter the encoder; target/control pulse on 600 target-class notes, wrong-region pulse on 600 wrong-class notes
protocol.eligibility_reset: zero at the start of each moving-note presentation; accumulate KC spikes only through the first connected DAN spike; discard before the next note
protocol.weight_commit: apply the LTD update at the end of the current moving-note presentation using eligibility measured at the scheduled connected-DAN spike; updated weights first affect the next note
protocol.evaluation: after training, replay one full x=1.0-to-0.0 note using frozen weights, teacher OFF and plasticity OFF; bin the maximum MBON05 voltage by the inherited 0.05 position grid; also record the inherited static 21-position map
pass_criteria: both teaching arms have moving-note action at all three positions in their own core (target 0.65/0.70/0.75; wrong 0.15/0.20/0.25)
actions remain within the arm-specific inherited halo, or at least 90% of outside-halo bins remain no-action
matched DAN-on/plasticity-off control has exact baseline weights and moving-note map and remains no-action
the trained moving-note maps persist with teacher and plasticity OFF
all 120 blocks and 1200 presentations complete per arm; each scheduled event activates all three DANs
all weight updates require positive current-presentation eligibility and an anatomically connected active DAN and remain within the union gamma4 mask
the immutable 20-percent original-weight floor, fixed encoder, threshold, and readout are preserved
protocol.stop_rule: one run only; no early stopping, parameter tuning, rerun, or Level 3B reopening

readout: inherited fixed MBON05 maximum-voltage threshold; no trained decoder
scope: replace static position presentations with a single moving note and current-position-only Gaussian drive; preserve Level 3B learning rule, anatomy gate, DAN ensemble, fixed readout and inherited training schedule
